native_mechanisms: Counting-bars plus eight violin strings bound under one bridge: one pluck shivers every string, so the whole wide state is the mixing engine
A fresh, never-repeated ink-weight (feather) per mark, folded into a running count so strict order is fixed and no two marks share a weight
The storm's single hands-off pass over the final tremor collapses it into a small fixed token, after which the pickers irreversibly destroy every discarded feather and drop
core_technique: Wide 8x64-bit ARX state absorbing 64-byte blocks: add message words plus per-block-incrementing lane constants, then a cross-lane permute/rotate/xor-add butterfly so each lane diffuses into all others; blank-input finalization rounds, then an irreversible 512->64 fold through MurmurHash3 fmix64 (the only multiplies).
